text.section: A person is guilty of the crime of personal trespass by computer when he uses a computer or computer network to cause physical injury to an individual.

If committed maliciously, the crime of personal trespass by computer shall be punishable as a Class 3 felony. If such act is done unlawfully but not maliciously, the crime of personal trespass by computer shall be punishable as a Class 6 felony.
